title: A canteen survey
body: The canteen committee of a school with 1200 students wants to plan the breakfast it prepares. Instead of asking every student, the committee surveys a random sample of 40 students from Class 9 about their favourite breakfast. The results are: idli 16 students, poha 10 students, paratha 8 students and upma 6 students. The committee plans to use these results to estimate how many students in the whole school are likely to prefer each item, and to decide how much of each item to prepare.
